entity_raw.definition_raw:
You are skilled at moving quickly through forbidding parts of cities.

Prerequisite(s): Street Smarts.

Benefit(s): You do not treat crowds as difficult terrain. You also gain an additional +2 bonus on Acrobatics checks to move along rooftops and on slippery sections of city streets and sewers.
